subject.title: fix(agents): treat codex exec_command as exec-like

question: Should this PR require live Codex app-server behavior proof before merge, or should maintainers explicitly accept the source-contract plus focused-test proof as sufficient for this environment-limited Codex path?
rationale: The patch shape is source-supported, but ClawSweeper's external-PR gate still requires real after-fix behavior proof unless a maintainer intentionally overrides it.

options.title: Require live Codex proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, linked artifact, or a recording that shows read-only `exec_command` suppression and mutating failure warnings after the patch.

options.title: Override proof sufficiency
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the Codex source contract and focused OpenClaw tests as enough despite the missing live app-server turn.

options.title: Pause until producer evidence exists
options.body: Keep the PR idle or close it if no one can show that raw `exec_command` reaches this warning path in the reported setup.

recommendation.title: Require live Codex proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, linked artifact, or a recording that shows read-only `exec_command` suppression and mutating failure warnings after the patch.
